text:
ravi: Quick heads-up — after yesterday's allocator tune (eager-coalesce=on) the canary for 16k-chat started hitting intermittent OOMs on p4d.
emily: ugh, saw a few traces too, thought it was batch packing at first.
anya: what exactly changed in the allocator? any diffs?
ravi: we enabled lazy workspace leasing + larger freelist buckets. diff below: 
```
- freelist_buckets: [64, 128, 256]
- eager_coalesce: false
+ freelist_buckets: [128, 256, 512]
+ eager_coalesce: true
+ workspace_leasing: lazy
```
cheng: lazy leasing should reduce hot-path contention but increases fragmentation risk for long-lived KV caches. Are the OOMs correlated with long prefix reuse?
david: profiling from yesterday (short run of 2 min load test) — KV cache hit rate stable, but scratchpad allocation spikes when sequence len > 8k. snippet: 
```
heaplet: scratchpad#3 growth +12MB/s
active_tensors: 432 -> 1180
peak_gpu_mem: 46.7GB -> 63.2GB
OOM at alloc tensor logits_scratch_0 size=1.2GB
```
emily: so logits/scratchpad growth is the culprit, not KV cache eviction. did the kernel selector change? we also rolled a tiny kernel selection tweak last week.
ravi: kernel selector unchanged in canary. suspect interaction: lazy leasing keeps some small slabs pinned, preventing reuse for logits/scratchpad which wants contiguous 1GB.
anya: can we repro with a focused harness? run 16k generation loop with forced prefix reuse to stress KV + scratchpad simultaneously. I'll add a variant to perf-suite.
perf-bot: scheduled perf job: perf-suite/16k-reuse-lazy-lease-2026-03-17 queued (job id: 9874). :gear:
david: added extra tracing in allocator: live-alloc-trace + slab-id tagging. will upload trace after job finishes.
cheng: quick mitigation: can we set workspace_leasing: eager but keep freelist_buckets larger? that should favor big contiguous allocations for logits while still reducing small alloc noise.
ravi: good idea. will test eager + current buckets and run limited canary. if stable, roll to all canaries then prod.
emily: also consider adding a fallback in runtime: if a contiguous allocation for logits fails but total free>=needed, perform a compact swap (evict small pinned slabs temporarily). risky but avoids OOM.
anya: we should also surface a metric in console: contiguous_free_bytes and largest_contiguous_block per GPU. currently we only expose total_free.
david: allocator trace shows a fragmentation spike coinciding with KV cache pin growth. attaching short summary in thread.
ravi: thanks. next steps: (1) run perf-suite job (anya) (2) test eager+big-buckets (ravi/david) (3) add contiguous_free metric proposal (anya/cheng). report back in ~4h. :thumbsup:
